info.title: Private aiKit QA queue
info.description: Queue allowlisted local QA tasks and read sanitized results. The local Windows bridge must be running. This API never accesses browser credentials.

post.summary: Queue an explicitly requested QA command
post.description: Use title AIKIT-QA: COMMAND and body AIKIT_QA_BRIDGE_V2 followed by a newline and JSON {version:2,command:COMMAND,params:{}}. Commands: SAFE_CHECKS, PUBLIC_REMAINING, PUBLIC_ALL, AUTH_SMOKE, RUN_SCENARIO, TEST_TOOL, RUN_NEXT, RESUME_CHECKLIST, RETEST, PROGRESS, LATEST, BLOCKED, PAUSE, RESUME, STOP. Never send executable code, credentials, arbitrary URLs, or mutation approval in an issue.

get.summary: Read the bridge result for a queued task

200.description: Comments containing sanitized result JSON; a claim alone is not completion
